title: Qualify 365 original artifacts and complete the opening grid
description: Apply the original Git rename when transplanting the unmasked test and disable the optional coverage-file enforcement for the skipped-test packaging phase. Both historical snapshot parents stay pinned. Capture all four public claims on the frozen opening fingerprint and verify raw JVM outcomes.

steps.name: Build unchanged artifacts and run the original regression
steps.run: export TMPDIR="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/in-the-loop/tmp"; repos=(); if test -d "${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/in-the-loop/external-upgrades/ci-sources/java-domain-proof/jackson-core"; then repos=(--repos "${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/in-the-loop/external-upgrades/ci-sources/java-domain-proof"); fi; python3 -B lib/benchmark/organic-java/upstream.py 365 --cases lib/benchmark/java-domain-proof/cases.json "${repos[@]}" --maven-cache "${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/in-the-loop/external-upgrades/maven" --output examples/365-jackson-async-token-offsets/records/qualified-build

steps.name: Measure four ordinary native claims and their finite JVM grid
